basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Technical Support Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The JIPMER Department of Nephrology will hold a walk-in for one Project Technical Support post on 27 November 2026. Candidates must report at 9.00 AM to the Department of Nephrology, JIPMER, Puducherry – 605006, with documents for verification. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed at 2.00 PM the same day. The post pays INR 33,600 (consolidated) and is a PhD-track project position.

age_limit.details: The age should be less than 35 years as on 30-09-2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation.

qualification.details: One post of Project Technical Support is to be filled. It is a PhD-track position: only candidates interested in pursuing a PhD in Nephrology (assessment of level of kidney function and related topics) may apply. The selected candidate is expected to appear for the eligibility exam conducted by JIPMER for enrolment in PhD (project track). important_instructions: Only candidates who can join by 02-12-2026 need to apply, as the position is to be filled on an urgent basis. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview. The appointee shall be on a full time appointment for this project and shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, during the appointment. The appointment can be terminated at any time with one month's notice without assigning any reason, or if the work is considered unsatisfactory by the competent authority. An appointee who wishes to resign has to serve one month's notice or remit one month's salary, proportionate to the shortfall in the notice period. The selected candidate will have no claim for regular appointment in JIPMER or continuation of service in any other project. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Clarifications can be sought in writing at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry
9.00 AM (interview of shortlisted candidates at 2.00 PM)
Candidates interested in a PhD in Nephrology who meet the qualification and can join by 02-12-2026

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is based in Puducherry. This notice is issued by its Department of Nephrology, where Dr. Sreejith Parameswaran, Professor, invites applications for the study "Refining kidney function assessment in Indians: Towards accurate estimation of glomerular filtration rate in clinical practice".

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Project Technical Support is to be filled. It is a PhD-track position: only candidates interested in pursuing a PhD in Nephrology (assessment of level of kidney function and related topics) may apply. The selected candidate is expected to appear for the eligibility exam conducted by JIPMER for enrolment in PhD (project track). The post-holder also supervises the project nurse's work. MSc Biochemistry, MSc Pharmacology, MSc Dialysis Therapy Technology, MSc MLT in Biochemistry or MSc Nursing MPH with graduate level qualification in Nursing, Lab technology or Dialysis technology A graduate Medical Degree in Modern Medicine (MBBS, BDS) from a recognized university or equivalent institution One year of experience in clinical research programs, in a role including study design, developing research protocol, preparing statistical analysis plan, compiling data, data cleaning, data analysis and manuscript writing. Applicants with research experience, good communication skills in Tamil and basic computer skills will be preferred. The age should be less than 35 years as on 30-09-2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation. The remuneration is INR 33,600/- (consolidated). Provident fund, HRA, CCA, Leave Travel Concession, medical claim and similar benefits are not applicable. The tenure is twelve months, which may be extended for the full project duration, on a purely temporary/contractual basis for the specified period and based on the project. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Proof for date of birth Proof of residence Qualification and experience certificates CV

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report to the Department of Nephrology at 9.00 AM on 27-11-2026 with documents and certificates for verification. Candidates will be shortlisted by a written test. Shortlisted candidates are then called for an interview scheduled at 2.00 PM on 27-11-2026 at the Department of Nephrology. The notice gives the mode of recruitment as written test and skill test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates who can join by 02-12-2026 need to apply, as the position is to be filled on an urgent basis. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview. The appointee shall be on a full time appointment for this project and shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, during the appointment. The appointment can be terminated at any time with one month's notice without assigning any reason, or if the work is considered unsatisfactory by the competent authority. An appointee who wishes to resign has to serve one month's notice or remit one month's salary, proportionate to the shortfall in the notice period. The selected candidate will have no claim for regular appointment in JIPMER or continuation of service in any other project. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Clarifications can be sought in writing at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the JIPMER Project Technical Support walk-in?
faq.answer: The walk-in is on 27-11-2026. Candidates report at 9.00 AM and shortlisted candidates are interviewed at 2.00 PM the same day.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Department of Nephrology, JIPMER, Puducherry – 605006.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one post of Project Technical Support.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: An MSc in Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Dialysis Therapy Technology, MLT in Biochemistry or Nursing, an MPH with graduate level qualification in Nursing, Lab technology or Dialysis technology, or a graduate Medical Degree in Modern Medicine (MBBS, BDS). Candidates must also be interested in a PhD in Nephrology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should be less than 35 years as on 30-09-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The remuneration is INR 33,600/- (consolidated). Provident fund, HRA, CCA, Leave Travel Concession and medical claim are not applicable.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring proof for date of birth, proof of residence, qualification and experience certificates, and your CV.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted by a written test, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview at 2.00 PM on 27-11-2026. The notice gives the mode of recruitment as written test and skill test.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary/contractual project post with a tenure of twelve months, which may be extended for the full project duration. The appointee has no claim for regular appointment in JIPMER.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview.
